stem: A store sells a sweater at a price of \(p\) dollars. During a sale, the store takes 20% off the price and then subtracts an \$8 coupon from the reduced price. Jana paid \$56 for the sweater during the sale. What is the value of \(p\)?
solution: After 20% off, the price is \(0.8p\). After the coupon, it is \(0.8p - 8\).

explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the result of applying the coupon before the 20% discount: \(0.8(p - 8) = 56\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the result of subtracting 8 from 56 instead of adding it: \(0.8p = 48\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the price after the 20% discount, \(0.8p\), not the original price \(p\).

verify:
p = symbols('p')
s = solve(Eq(Rational(4, 5)*p - 8, 56), p)[0]
assert s == 80
assert value(choices[answer]) == s
assert all(value(choices[k]) != s for k in choices if k != answer)
